reviews.comment:
Ni 1 estrella le doy, la mala predisposición para
atender en la cafetería es de terror. Para comprar me pedía la credencial, y yo hace años compro con la aplicación, tengo 189 puntos y no se porque no me permitió comprar con los puntos. Pero ésto es así, cuando los querés usar. No compré, salgo y le comento al playero, y me dijo q a ellos q son compañeros los trata así! Un desastre. Si no le gusta el trabajo q se quede en su casa.

(Translated by Google)
I wouldn't even give it one star. The poor attitude towards customer service at the cafeteria is appalling. To buy something, they asked for my membership card, and I've been using the app for years. I have 189 points, and I don't know why they wouldn't let me use them. But that's how it is when you want to use them. I didn't buy anything, I left and told the attendant, and he said that he treats his colleagues the same way! A disaster. If he doesn't like his job, he should stay home.

reviewReply.comment: Gracias por tu comentario. Lamentamos que tu experiencia no haya sido la esperada. Tomamos en cuenta lo que nos comentás para seguir mejorando y esperamos tener otra oportunidad de atenderte mejor.

reviews.comment:
(Translated by Google) A simple and functional gas station in Villa La Angostura. ⛽️🇦🇷

During our stay, it was our go-to place for refueling, especially since we didn't see many other options in town. I received good service, refueled normally, and everything worked as it should.

One interesting thing for us Brazilians was that the tire inflator is paid for. You put in a small amount and the compressor is activated for a few minutes to inflate your tires. It was something different from what we're used to in Brazil.

Otherwise, it fulfills its function well: practical, well-located, and with relaxed service. 👍🏾

(Original)
Um posto simples e funcional em Villa La Angostura. ⛽️🇦🇷

Durante nossa estadia foi nossa referência para abastecer, até porque não vimos muitas outras opções na cidade. Fui bem atendido, abasteci normalmente e tudo funcionou como deveria.

Uma curiosidade para nós, brasileiros, foi o calibrador de pneus ser pago. Você coloca um pequeno valor e o compressor é liberado por alguns minutos para fazer a calibragem. Foi algo diferente do que estamos acostumados no Brasil.

No restante, cumpre bem a função: prático, bem localizado e atendimento tranquilo. 👍🏾
